title: Frank Critzer, Nazi agent killed at Giant Rock
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Frank Critzer, Nazi agent killed at Giant Rock, about World War II at Giant Rock, California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So uh this this structure under the rock where George Vanessa lived used to be owned by a Nazi called Frank Croitzer.

plain: Giant Rock is a huge boulder in the California desert, and a man named George Van Tassel later lived in a structure dug out beneath it. A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that this structure used to belong to a Nazi named Frank Critzer, who in the story was a Nazi agent around the time of World War II and was killed at the rock. If it were true, a famous desert site would have a hidden wartime spy story behind it.
